payloads.name: PrefBar
payloads.description: On-screen performance overlay (FPS, frametimes, 1% lows, temps, RAM/VRAM). Config at http://<PS5-IP>:8998/

payloads.name: GTAVI-UnlockFPS
payloads.description: GTA VI FPS unlocker (game v01.002.001). Load BEFORE starting the game. Settings: /data/gtavi-unlockfps/fps.txt

payloads.name: PoorDS4
payloads.description: Use a wireless DualShock 4 in native PS5 games and homebrew. Connect the DS4 first, then load. No vibration.

payloads.name: PoorDS4-stop
payloads.description: Stops a running PoorDS4. Run it before loading a newer PoorDS4 build.
